appTagline: Official Notice Change Monitor for Farmers

footer.honesty: Information here is monitored from official sources at scheduled intervals and reviewed by a person before it is shown. It can be late or wrong. It is not an official determination of eligibility. Always confirm on the official portal linked in each alert.
footer.notOfficial: Not an official government website • Prototype for verified change detection
footer.privacy: Privacy First: We never collect Aadhaar, bank credentials, or caste data.
